answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 29942 Country: India Title: Using tobacco powder (masheri)for tooth brushing is lawful ? Question: using tobacco powder (masheri)for tooth brushing is lawful ? Answer ID: 29942 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 322/322/M=1432) If the tobacco powder is not intoxicating, stinking and injurious to health, then its use is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
